resources.string: Settings, Guide & FAQ
Display preferences, usage tips and data protection
💡 Tips for the best transcription
1. Speak naturally
No need to over-articulate: the AI removes hesitations and verbal tics.
2. Pick the right format
Choose \'Pro email\' for a client, or \'Minutes\' to extract actions into a checklist.
3. Edit before exporting
You can edit the raw transcript at any time and regenerate the deliverable with another tone.
❓ Frequently Asked Questions
How does transcription work?
The app captures the audio stream from your microphone and uses AI models to turn speech into text and instantly structure your deliverables.
Are my recordings private and secure?
In line with the GDPR and Google Play privacy policies, your recordings are stored locally on your device and protected. You can erase them at any time.
How do I change the tone of a document?
On the generated deliverable card, just tap one of the tone buttons (Formal, Casual, Concise): the AI rewrites the text in seconds without re-recording.
How do I change the language or switch to dark mode?

At the top of this screen, choose Light, Dark or System for the display, and Français, English or the device language for menus. The sun / moon button on the Home screen switches day / night in one tap. The language of AI deliverables is set with the FR / EN switch on the Home screen.
🔒 Personal data & GDPR
Right to erasure
You have full control over your audio and text data. You can delete all your notes and local files in a single tap.
Delete all my notes and data
Confirm deletion?
All your voice notes, transcripts and related audio files will be permanently erased from your device.
Delete permanently
All your data has been deleted.
